minimal_evaluable_floor_for_next_batch.use: smallest review-only next batch to make cells evaluable enough for diagnostic adjudication

stable_metric_targets.use: future stable metric target only; not achieved by this proposal

non_negotiables.cofactor_evidence_policy: Cofactor labels must be supported by experimental ligand/local structure context or source-reviewed cofactor records, not inferred circularly from mechanism fingerprint labels.
non_negotiables.external_policy: External candidates are provenance-tagged and remain non-countable until materialization, duplicate/leakage, expert, factory, and future split gates pass.
non_negotiables.mcsa_policy: M-CSA rows are eval-only unless already present in frozen current702; all M-CSA candidates are explicitly provenance-tagged and not import-ready.
non_negotiables.oos_fp_policy: OOS-FP remains a hard gate for future evaluation; any nonzero OOS false-positive rate blocks metric promotion.
